Not that I liked Chiaralli but i'm curious to see what everyone thinks of Don Sweeny and the new direction the Bruins are taking in general.
What does everyone think of new genereal manager Don Sweeny now that the draft is done?

Islanders fan here, you guys seemed to get hosed in that draft. Am I missing something? I know you needed to cut cap space but it seems like Sweeny just threw everything out almost at random. But that's just my thoughts.
Yeah, I definitely thought we came out of the draft in an bad place. There's a difference between cutting the cap and restructuring, I think the draft was his way of putting his mark on the team.

I like the way Sweeney has handled the team so far. I wasn't thrilled with the Hamilton deal, BUT I knew something had to be done. It is pretty clear that Doug did not want to stay in Boston. I am of the mindset that it doesn't make sense to make a player stay on a team he doesn't want to play for. He could have gotten more for him a year from now...maybe, maybe not.

In terms of drafting: I like the approach. The Bruins knew which guys they wanted and they got them. They aren't going to take chances on guys just because they are "the best on the board." While I think they reached a bit, I think nabbing YOUR guys is important. I was also impressed with the rumours that Sweeney was trying to get the No. 3 pick.

I love the Lucic trade. I was not a Lucic fan and I am glad to see him go. We got a good return, especially when you count in the Jones to SJS move.

Overall, I am in LOVE with the philosophy of: "You need to want to be here." I think Chia brought in guys and they got complacent. So for Sweens to get guys who are from MA and want to be here, I think it is a huge step in the right direction. Sweeney is making the right moves, IMO. It will be interesting to see if Claude Julien can adapt to what Sweeney has given him or if Julien will continue to be a problem.
